about: The secreta of the formulary “17th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, we humbly pray Your Majesty that the holy rite which we are celebrating may free us from past and future sins. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: suppliantly, in an attitude of humble entreaty
